creator: Alexander Terp
description: From a_32xp9owqt's reports: `pane send "<long text>" --enter --confirm` exited 0 with the text sitting unsent in a just-started pane. Confirmation can see the text in the input box without knowing whether the Return submitted it. Not reproduced while building a_32xp9owqt, which fixed only keyed sends returning before the redraw. Raised by factory run muster-1119-iris.
title: A paste sent to a just-started pane with --enter --confirm can exit 0 with the text left unsent
